materiality: VibeVoice-ASR counted padded audio samples with float32 division before ceil; beyond 2^24 samples, precision loss can undercount the model-visible audio-token length by one relative to the processor's integer/float64 expectation.
The repair uses exact integer ceiling division, making this a long-audio speech correctness boundary rather than a cosmetic arithmetic refactor.
requiredEvidence: Bind exact Transformers package/source, VibeVoice-ASR checkpoint, processor/tokenizer, hop length, audio bytes/hash, dtype and device/runtime identity.
Build a known-bad predecessor oracle around sample counts immediately below/at/above 2^24 and hop-length boundaries; require processor and model audio-token counts to agree exactly on the candidate.

Exercise padded and unpadded batches, long-form audio including representative hour-scale inputs when resources permit, chunk/timestamp/diarization modes actually exposed, and cancellation/restart; compare transcript/token/timestamp results against the qualified baseline.
Do not rehost model weights for this evaluation; preserve rollback and mark unavailable full-model long-audio hardware UNAVAILABLE rather than transferring the arithmetic fixture PASS.

materiality: LoRA hotswap resolved rank_pattern and alpha_pattern against a full state-dict key instead of the module name used by normal loading, so matching patterns could be missed and scaling silently change even when reloading the same checkpoint.
The repair aligns hotswap pattern resolution with ordinary loading and adds compiled/rslora pattern regressions; live adapter switching therefore requires fresh equivalence evidence.
requiredEvidence: Bind exact PEFT/Torch/Transformers versions, base-model bytes, every adapter/config hash, rank/alpha patterns, rslora state, compile mode and serving/training owner revision.

Known-bad control must show normal load versus hotswap scaling/output divergence for matching module-name patterns; candidate must reproduce the normal-load output across exact, regex-like and missing-target pattern cases.

Exercise A->B->A swaps, same-checkpoint reload, torch.compile prepared hotswap, rslora on/off, cancellation/failure/rollback and concurrent serving isolation where the owner exposes live swaps; no stale adapter may remain active after error.
Search historical SZL receipts for the affected hotswap lifecycle and mark demonstrated exposure NEEDS_REVALIDATION; package presence alone is not evidence of corruption.

materiality: KTO's Liger chunked projection reads lm_head.weight directly; when loss calculation bypassed a distributed wrapper forward, DDP gradient-reducer hooks could remain unarmed even though ZeRO-3/FSDP-specific paths were redirected.
The repair redirects whenever the model is wrapped (or FSDP is active), making this a distributed post-training gradient-integrity boundary.
requiredEvidence: Bind exact TRL/Liger/Accelerate/Torch versions, KTO config, base checkpoint, dataset fixture, seed, topology and accelerator/runtime identities.

Reproduce the predecessor under DDP with a deterministic tiny model and compare single-process oracle versus DDP loss, lm_head gradients and one optimizer update; candidate must agree within predeclared tolerances and prove reducer participation.
Repeat applicable controls under ZeRO-3, FSDP/FSDP2, gradient accumulation, checkpoint/resume, rank failure/restart and uneven/empty local batches; unsupported topology remains UNAVAILABLE.

No historical training receipt inherits qualification; demonstrate affected KTO+Liger+distributed exposure before marking any prior receipt NEEDS_REVALIDATION, and preserve rollback to the qualified trainer path.

materiality: Disk group offload could free onloaded device tensors while the compute stream still read them; allocator reuse could feed foreign data to an in-flight kernel and produce NaNs.
The candidate synchronizes before disk offload when a separate stream is used without record_stream, closing a device-memory lifetime boundary that affects generated media correctness.
requiredEvidence: Bind exact Diffusers/Torch/accelerator versions, model/pipeline bytes, group-offload configuration, stream/record_stream settings, disk path/filesystem and seed/input hashes.
Reproduce the upstream VidTok-style known-bad disk-offload path under allocator reuse pressure; require the predecessor NaN/corruption sentinel and candidate finite deterministic result.

Compare disk offload, memory offload and no-offload outputs/latents across leaf/block modes, separate/default streams, record_stream true/false, repeated runs, cancellation and restart; correctness precedes throughput/memory claims.
Preserve exact output/latent hashes or declared numerical tolerances, clean temporary files on failure, retain rollback and mark missing accelerator/offload capacity UNAVAILABLE.

materiality: TritonMLA multi-token decode needs one block-table and sequence-length row per query token; without correct flattening/causal per-row extents the decode kernel can read outside metadata rows or let a verify token attend future draft siblings.

The repair expands metadata, assigns causal prefix-plus-position lengths, keeps padding at zero, and explicitly refuses causal multi-token decode under DCP where local sequence lengths make that arithmetic unsafe.
requiredEvidence: Bind exact vLLM source/image, model/MLA configuration, Triton/Torch/CUDA-or-ROCm versions, query length, page size, graph mode, DCP/TP topology and accelerator identity.

Run the immediate predecessor as a known-bad metadata/kernel sentinel for causal multi-token query lengths 2,3,4,5,8; candidate must expand block_table/seq_lens per q row and enforce prefix-plus-own-position causality with zero KV extent on padding rows.

Exercise non-causal and single-token controls, cudagraph padding, request concurrency/reordering, cancellation/restart, malformed/non-uniform blocks and explicit DCP causal rejection; unsupported combinations must fail before kernel launch.

Where hardware exists, add memory-safety/poison-canary execution plus logits/output parity against a trusted attention oracle; preserve rollback and never infer GPU safety from metadata-only unit tests.

materiality: http_get measured expected size from the file object's absolute position, so a caller-supplied file already positioned after its own bytes failed consistency checks even when the downloaded payload was correct.

If a server ignored Range, predecessor recovery could seek to byte zero and truncate caller-owned prefix bytes; the repair rewinds only to the download start and measures bytes downloaded by the call.
requiredEvidence: Bind exact huggingface_hub source/package, HTTP fixture response bytes, Range behavior, destination-file prefix/suffix bytes and filesystem semantics used by the consuming owner.

Known-bad controls must cover a nonzero initial file position with Range honored and Range ignored; verify predecessor consistency failure and/or prefix truncation, then require candidate preservation of all caller-owned bytes plus exact downloaded payload hash.

Exercise retries/resume, append/update modes, expected-size mismatch, partial reads, network failure, cancellation and restart; an error must preserve preexisting bytes and must not convert an incomplete artifact to success.

Do not bump a production Hub dependency from this discovery alone; qualify the exact consuming path, preserve v1.32 rollback where applicable, and publish only exact artifact/runtime receipts after normal source admission.
